source: A kernel with many independent requests can fill the memory pipeline and approach high bandwidth. A pointer-chasing kernel may expose only one dependent request at a time, preventing the system from building the same level of concurrency. Both can access the same ZXNAME0000XZ.
zh: 具有许多独立请求的内核可以填充内存管道并接近高带宽。指针追逐内核一次可能只公开一个相关请求，从而阻止系统构建相同级别的并发性。两者都可以访问相同的ZXNAME0000XZ。
